data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 雪霞狼长枪靠墙时的监视宣言
data.action: 榻榻米被褥上端庄正坐，双手叠膝微红着脸昂首宣布
data.lighting: 和风月色与角落纸灯笼的清冷与温润交错光
data.camera: 平视牛仔景，完整展现雪霞狼长琴盒与正坐姿态
data.mood: 认真正经，反差傲娇可爱
data.description: 弦神岛深夜微风吹拂的和室。狮子王机关的剑巫雪菜刚沐浴完毕，换上一尘不染的白亚麻高领长睡裙。灵格神枪“雪霞狼”的长琴盒端正倚在墙角。雪菜在榻榻米被褥上端正正坐，两手规整地搭在双膝上。虽然双颊浮上一抹微红，眼神却依然一本正经地宣告贴身监视第四真祖是不可推卸的职责，严禁前辈笑话睡裙保守。
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet tatami room at night, Yukina sits in disciplined seiza upon her futon, maintaining her solemn sword-shaman vigil. She is clothed in an immaculate high-neck white linen nightgown with subtle talismanic embroidery. Resting beside the wall is the elongated violin case holding her sacred spear Schneewalzer. Looking upward with flushed cheeks and determined amber eyes, her serious expression carries an adorable tsundere earnestness.
data.animaCaption: Sitting seiza on the tatami futon in her white linen nightgown, guarding her spear case with a blushing, serious expression.
